method: Five consecutive browser Run again actions on the public site with the Hugging Face A100 endpoint already warm. Each run made a new Roboflow request. Server-side timings exclude browser network/rendering. The browser held a review request open until Sprite completed.
result: 5/5 runs completed. Three-region Jev stage took 0.8–1.2 s and first Jev result 0.4–0.6 s. All three labels were Fan in each run; this is not evidence of accuracy.
before_fix: Two earlier live runs without the held request took 27.9 and 32.5 s for the three-region Jev stage. A diagnostic with repeated status requests took 8.5 s.
cost_note: The A100 is charged by instance running time at the configured $2.50/hour until scale-to-zero; per-request compute estimates in session traces are not the Hugging Face invoice.
